book.name: JON
book.title: Jon imi tebe Yesus imi sang dola kosa uta ko

content: Nagalal ninggil imi aget fugunolipta, Yesus beyo God imi Man ba kalaa agesip uta ko
Bii-nala e, Yesus iyo utamata e, Juda kasel imi kamogimal iyo, nangkolum o agan-bilip kalaa age-nalata, iyo, Provins Yuudiya ku-tele tiinemaali o age-nalata, Provins Galili kugol tiinema ko.
Juda kasel imi ifin am ko age Kuun At Bubuul Am Sinamin am uyo mep so tuluta,

Yesus imi nagalal ninggil iyo bogobe-nilip e, “Tinum maak iyo, kek kek ita nitaman o agelan-tema uyo, imi kuguup migik uyo bantap kanuman-temaala kale, kem diim kal kanuman-tema kale, mungkup kapkal, kanupmin kuguup bo kanuman o agelap umdii, kapkal te tam kem diim no unang tinum kwiin tagang imi tiin diim kugol kanu-balapta a. Provins Galili koyo kupkaa Provins Yuudiya no-nalapta, kapmi kuguup ugulumi migik uyo kanu-balapta, unang tinum siin Yuudiya kugol bom kapmi deng tebemsip bilip iyo katamin o,” agelip ko.
Kale imi nagalal iyo, beyo God imi Man ba kalaa age-nilipta, weng boyo bogobelip ko.
Yesus iyo bogobela, “Nimi am uyo daanin-tem albu kale minte, suun kup am daanan-temu koyo, ibo, ‘Numi am daanbu o,’ agan-nuubip kale,
kafin diim komi unang tinum iyo ipmi itafinonan-temaalip kale minte, niyo bilip imi kuguup mafak kem-nuubip umi sang uta baga-e-bilita, nitafinon-nuubip ko.
Kale kamano koyo ipkil ifin am uyo utaman Jerusalam unin a. Kale minte nimi am uyo daanin-tem albu kale, kamano koyo nita ifin am koyo no utaman-temaali o,” age-nala e,
Provins Galili kugol na ko.
Iman tigi-bilip, Yesus imi no Jerusalam kal unang tinum kafalemsa uta ko
Yesus imi nagalal ninggil iyo daaginip e, siit-nala e, yagal ifin am utaman una kuta, iyo kem diim ilep unaala kale, bantap ilep una ko.
Kale ifin am daanbu kota, Juda kasel imi kamogimal iyo Yesus imi atamin-tem ke-bom-nilipta, fen-bom-nilip e, “Beyo dogap kal alba o?” agan-kalip ko.

Kale unang tinum kwiin tagang iyo bantap weng buguna tala ke-bom-nilip e, maak ita bogolip, “Beyo tinum tambal o,” agan-bilip e, maak ita bogolip, “E-e, beyo unang tinum iyo bisop baga-emin o,” agan-bom no kemip kuta,
iyo Juda kasel imi kamogimal imi atul finano-nilipta, tinum iyo maak Yesus imi sang uyo kem diim kugol bagamin-tem kelip ko.
Kale ifin am daanbu uyo biniman tal-buluta, Yesus iyo tam ulotu am miton tam-nalata, unang tinum kafalema ko.

Kale Juda kasel imi kamogimal iyo imi weng bagan-be uyo tinangku-nilipta, kumang mo-nilip e, bogolip, “Tinum kanupmin keyo Baibel skul umaak kesaala kale, dogap kal aget fugunin ko dagaa kusata, kam agan-be o?” agelip e,
Yesus isiik bogobe-nala e, “Kafale-bii koyo nalami aget fugunin uta kup kafalebaali kale, God nimdala ti-sii imi weng uta kup baga-e-bii ko.

Kanube tinum iyo maak, God imi aget fugunin uta kup waafulan o agela umdii, kanubelan-tema uyo, iyo nimi weng bagan-bii koyo utamata e, God ita bogobelata, bagan-be e? Yagal bisop ilami aget fugunin weng bagan-be e? nagelan-tema ko.

Tinum iyo maak ilami aget fugunin weng kup bagan-be umdii, beyo, ‘Kanu-bilita, unang tinum bilip iyo win kufop-namin o,’ agan-be minte, tinum iyo maak, God nimdala ti-sii bemi win kufobelan o agan-be umdii, beyo weng bisop bagamin binim, tol tinum ko.
Kale sugamiyok uyo Moses iyo ulo ko age weng kwep daasa kuta, alugum ibo ulo boyo tele waafusaalip binim ko. Kale ibo, intaben o ageta nangkolum o agan-bilip o?” agela e,
unang tinum isiik bogobe-nilip e, “Sinik mafak iyo maak du mo-bomta bagake-be aga? Iyo waantap ita, kangkolum o agan-bilip o?” agelip e,
Yesus iyo imi weng mobe-nala e, “Niyo God imi ifin am daan-suu kota, mirakel ko age kuguup ugulumi migik tambal maak ke-sii boyo, ibo kumang mo bubul mafak kebe-suu ko.

Moses iyo ulo maak kobe kafalebesa boyo, man tinum iyo dolu am ifaan kal kela uyo kaal ukan ke-emin kale, ibo utamipta e, man imi am ifaan kal kela koyo, God imi ifin am daanu kalaa agelip ugol imi kaal ukan ke-em-nuubip ko. Kale Moses ita kup kanupmin kuguup boyo kobesaala kale, olal imi siin kuguup kale, Moses imi mo kugupmipta, Moses yagal ibo kafalebesa ko.

Kale ibo, Moses imi weng kwep daasa uyo waafulum o agan-bom-nilipta, God imi ifin am daanu uyo, ibo, man kaal ukan ke-e-bomta bo tambaliim o agan-nuubip kale, nagal mungkup ifin am maak daanuta, tinum beyo telela doli tambalanba kale, ibo intaben o ageta olsak kupkane-bilip a?
Bisop uyo tiin uta kup nitamamin ba kale, tele nitama-bomta, tambaliim ke-be kalaa, mafak ke-be kalaa nagan-kalin o,” agela ko.
Daga-nilip, “Tinum keyo God imi ulaa dula kamok kesa tinum ita bele ki?” agesip uta ko
Jerusalam kasel iip maak maak iyo bogo-nilip e, “Tinum keyo kamogimal iyo, angkolum o agan-bilip ita maak kale,

be atamin. Tal kwiin tagang tem kagal mo-bom ilimi tiin diim kagal weng bagan-be boyo, kamogimal iyo weng umaak bogobe-nimip binim ke-bilip ko. Kamogimal bilip iyo atamta, fen beyo God imi ulaa dula kamok kesa tinum ita kalaa agebip kuta, nuyo bogobelin-tem kebip bele a?
Umbae. Nuyo utamupta, beyo ku-tele talba kalaa agebup kale minte, God imi ulaa dula kamok kesa tinum imi tolon-tema uyo, utamta, ku-tele talba kalaa agon-temaalup o,” agelip ko.

Kale Yesus iyo ulotu am miton kutam kal kafale-bom-nalata, fomtuup weng baga-e-bom-nala e, “Ibo niyo, atamsup ko nagan-bom-nilip e, dogap-tele ti-se ko nagan-bom no ke-bilip kuta, ibo tele nitamsaalip ko. Niyo nagal tisaali kale, fen God iyo alba kale, yagal nimdala ti-sii kuta, ibo tele atamsaalip kale,
nita atamsi ko. Ulim maagup bom-nulupta, nimdala ti-sii kale, atamsi o,” agela ko.
Kam agelata, sagaal togobe aafulum o agelip kuta, imi kaanan-tema umi am uyo daanin-tem albu kale, God ita fegelebelata, tinum iyo maak sagaal togopmomip binim kelip ko.

Kuta tinum kwiin tagang Yesus imi ilak dolip iyo bogo-nilip e, “God imi ulaa dula kamok kesa tinum imi tolon-tema uyo, imi mirakel ko age kuguup ugulumi migik migik kanuman-tema bota tinum kemi mirakel ko age kuguup ugulumi migik migik ko kanum tebesa uyo kubaganan-temaalu kale, God imi ulaa dula kamok kesa tinum Krais iyo kalba o,” agelip ko.
Yesus ilami kaanan-tema umi sang baga-emsa uta ko

Unang tinum kwiin tagang iyo Yesus imi sang baga-bilipta, Falosi iyo tolong dolipta, bagan-bilip kalaa agelipta, Falosi sino tinum amem ko age pris imi kamogimal sino iyo un tubulin imdalip no, Yesus aafulum o ageta unip ko.
Yesus iyo imi kaanan-tema umi sang uyo unang tinum bogobe-nala e, “Niyo ipso siit ilugolan-temaali kale, niyo imka-nilita, asok God nimdala ti-sii imi finang unon-temi kale,
nimi no kugol nan-temi boyo, ibo bagang-kale te no tolon-temaalip kale, ibo nimi fenan-temip kuta, nitaman-temaalip o,” agela ko.

Juda kasel imi kamogimal iyo weng bogobina tala ke-bom-nilip e, tegenip, “Iyo dogap iinata, nuyo ataman-temaalup a? Beyo nuyo imkaa unanbu no Juda kasel siin daage no Grik kasel imi abiip maak maak kal baga-e-bom kafaleman-tema bele a?

Iyo bogo-nala, ‘Nimi no kugol nan-temi uyo ibo bagang-kaleta te no tolon-temaalip o,’ age-nala e minte, weng maak bogo-nala e, ‘Ibo nimi fenan-temip kuta, nitaman-temaalip o,’ age no kela kale, weng bomi magam uyo intaben o?” agan-kalip ko.
Yesus imi, unang tinum imi suun nin umi ok kobelan o agesa uta ko

Ifin am umi am afung am daanbu uyo am kwiin kiim daanbu kale, Yesus iyo kota te tam unang tinum imi tiin diim kal mo-nala e, fomtuup bogola, “Ibaa. Waantap kapta ok tep tebepkebu umdii, nimi finang talapta, suun nin umi ok uyo kopkelita, unelal a.

God iyo suuk kon tem weng uyo bogo-nala e, ‘Waantap ita nimi ilak dolan-temip iyo nimi suun nin umi ok kaanamin binim uyo kobelita, suun kup imi aget tem uyo dongen-nulu e, bisi-buluta, kek kek iyo dong daga-eman-temip o,’ agesa o,” agela ko.

Yesus iyo God imi Sinik imi sang uyo felep yak ku tota do weng boyo bogola kale, bomi magam uyo bogo-nala e, “Unang tinum waantap ita nimi ilak dolan-temip uyo, God tebe ilami Sinik iyo bilip imi dobelan-tema o,” agela ko. Kale am ko daan-bom-bulu uyo, Yesus iyo kafin koyo kupkaa God imi finang unin-tem kale, God iyo ilami Sinik iyo daala malaak tilin-tem bom-salata, Yesus imi weng bo, “Dobelan-tema o,” agela ko.
Unang tinum imi Yesus imi kalan wengaal diginsip uta ko
Unang tinum kwiin tagang iyo weng bo tolong do-nilip e, milii iyo bogolip, “Aafentap kuba. Tinum beyo profet ko age God imi weng kem baga-emin tinum tolon-tema o age fen-nuubip ita kuba o,” agelip e,

unang tinum milii iyo bogo-nilip e, “E-e, iyo God imi tinum ulaa dula kamok kesa ita kuba,” agelip kuta, unang tinum milii iyo bogo-nilip e, “E-e, God imi tinum ulaa dula kamok ke tolon-tema beyo Provins Galili kayaak ba kwa.

God imi suuk kon tem weng uyo bogo-nulu e, ‘God imi tinum ulaa dula kamok ke tolon-tema iyo Devit imi man ilop o,’ age-nulu e minte, ‘Devit imi abiip miton Betleam kugol dolan-temu o,’ age no kesu o,” agelip no ko.
Kale unang tinum iyo Yesus imi kalan ilo ko yak una mek una keta wengaal digin-kalip ko.
Tinum iip maak maak iyo, Yesus iyo aafulum o agan-bilip kuta, tinum iyo maak Yesus iyo aafu-nimip binim kelip ko.
Kamogimal imi Yesus imi ilak dosaalip uta ko
Un tubulin iyo Yesus iyo dupka-nilip e, asok Falosi so tinum amem ko age pris imi kamogimal so imi finang no tamip e, iyo dagalip, “Ibo intaben o ageta iyo aafuu dep tilin-tem o?” agelip e,
un tubulin iyo weng uyo mobe-nilip e, “Siin uyo tinum iyo maak tinum bemi kanupmin weng tambal boyo maak bagan-nuubaala kalaa age-nulupta, dupkaa tulup o,” agelip e,
Falosi iyo bogobelip, “Beyo ibo bisop bogobe no kelata, ‘Dam bagan-be o,’ age-nilipta, dupkaa tilip aga?
Kamogimal sino Falosi sino numi tinum iyo maak bemi ilak dosaala binim kuba.
Kale unang tinum Yesus imi ilak dolin iyo ulo utamsaalip kale, God iyo itamata e, bilip iyo maagalo kelip kalaa agesa kuba,” agelip ko.
Kale Falosi albip bilip imi tinum maak Nikodimus siin no Yesus so weng bagamsa beta ipkumal imi bogobela,

“Numi ulo uyo bogo-nulu e, ‘Ibo tinum iyo bisop uyo dep weng telelmin baan diim daagamin ba kale, kamaki imi weng uyo tolong do-nilipta, imi weng so kuguup so uta tele utam-nilipta, kota dep weng telelmin baan diim daalin o,’ agesu o,” agela e,

iyo titul weng bogobe-nilipta, weng uyo mobelip, “Kabo Provins Galili tinum kale, kam agelap aga? Kabo God imi weng uyo tele tiki-nalapta, utamapta e, ‘Galili tinum iyo maak mitam profet kelan-tema o,’ agesaalu kalaa age-nalapta o,” agelip ko.
